text:
alex_sales: Quick kickoff — Ember (Emma) wants to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. Request: short POC for endpoint parity, pricing delta, and security questionnaire answers. @pierre_se can you lead the tech POC?

pierre_se: I can. Need: scrubbed top-40 prompt set, 3 sample traces, which endpoints are used (chat/completions/embeddings), peak RPS, and token distribution. Also confirm whether they use system messages extensively.

emma_client: We'll share a scrubbed JSONL + two traces. Main endpoints: /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Peak ~160 rps, average token len ~280. Sending to your email.

infra-bot: staging org created: ember-poc-stg (keys expire in 9 days).

pierre_se: POC plan (sketch):
1) Day 0: onboarding (keys, IP allowlist).
2) Day 1: request/response mapping and 500-sample smoke side-by-side.
3) Day 2: prompt-parity eval + 100-regression tests from customer.
4) Day 3: perf tuning (batching, KV cache), cost delta report. Deliverables: mapping doc, parity report (diff samples), 1-page cost comparison.

jamal_product: Mapping note: CompetitorX quick-gen ~ rwd-fast-1; chat-pro ~ chat-rt. Known diffs: stop-token and system-message stitching. We'll add a small prompt-normalization pass in the harness to reduce noise. Also propose logging 100 representative diffs for product review.

nora_security: Security needs: completed questionnaire, architecture diagram, data classification, KMS requirements, and any residency constraints. Turnaround ~48-72h after docs arrive. Email security@redwood.com and cc thread. If traces contain PII they must be redacted.

pierre_se: Smoke example to include for their engineers:
```
# CompetitorX
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/generate
{ "prompt": "Extract tasks:\n- Update docs\n- Ship hotfix", "max_tokens": 120 }
# Redwood equivalent
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Extract tasks:\n- Update docs\n- Ship hotfix","max_tokens":120}'
```

alex_sales: Pricing ask: Ember wants 6mo commit pricing vs PAYG. Ballpark: hosted commit discounts ~25% 6mo, ~35% 12mo depending on volume. Dedicated/reserved quoted separately. I'll draft SOW/pricing.

emma_client: Procurement timeline: draft SOW by next Tue, security will start questionnaire Mon. Need explicit language about log retention & deletion after POC.

nora_security: We can offer a 14-day retention for POC logs and a temporary KMS binding. We'll add retention language to the SOW appendix.

jamal_product: Operational fallback: enable quantized 8-bit variant under overload and log sample diffs to parity bucket. Add deterministic stop-token post-processing in harness to reduce spurious diffs.

pierre_se: Action items: I'll upload a 1-page POC plan + model mapping doc by EOD tomorrow. Nora to confirm security turnaround and provide questionnaire link. Infra to share IP allowlist details. Alex to draft SOW and pricing. Sync Fri 9am PT.

emma_client: Confirmed — procurement contact: procure@ember.io, security contact: sec@ember.io. We'll get the questionnaire back within 48 hours.

alex_sales: Thanks all — tagging @pierre_se @nora_security @infra-bot. I'll send calendar invite and SOW stub. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
